study_identification_part.si_4_title: Deep Normative Tractometry for Identifying Joint White Matter Macro- and Micro-structural Abnormalities in Alzheimer's Disease

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TractoInferno (N=198) for pre-training and NIMHANS (N=123 CN, 89 MCI, 90 AD) for fine-tuning and inference.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The pre-training dataset was composed of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset... We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort... The dataset consists of neuroimaging data from 123 cognitively normal participants (CN), 89 diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and 90 with AD.

answer.NIMHANS: fine-tuning (50 CN); inference/validation (remaining CN, MCI, AD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TractoInferno was used for generative pre-training of the ConvVAE model. From the NIMHANS dataset, 50 CN subjects were used for fine-tuning the model, while the remaining CN and all MCI/AD subjects were used for inference and group comparison.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The model... was pretrained... on the TractoInferno dataset. Fifty CN subjects from the NIMHANS dataset... were then used to fine-tune the model... At inference time, bundle profiles from the remaining CN, MCI, and AD subjects were passed through the model...
